# Oxy

> Oxy is an independent, open-source ecosystem of ethical technology built to empower people, not exploit them.

## Primary pages

- [Oxy](https://oxy.so/): Overview of the ecosystem and its principles.
- [Newsroom](https://oxy.so/newsroom/): Product updates, engineering articles and company announcements.
- [Developers](https://oxy.so/developers/): Developer resources and documentation.
- [Company](https://oxy.so/company/): Information about Oxy and its mission.

## Oxy AI

Oxy AI is the umbrella for Oxy's AI platform, products and services. It is not a
model, and it is not the same thing as Alia.

- [Oxy AI](https://oxy.so/ai/): The umbrella landing — what the platform is made of.
- [Oxy Inference](https://oxy.so/ai/inference/): The public inference service. One OpenAI-compatible API for every model Oxy is approved to serve. Currently in private preview.
- [Models](https://oxy.so/ai/models/): The public model catalogue — publisher, capabilities, serving regions, data policy, price and availability per model.
- [Pricing](https://oxy.so/ai/pricing/): Per-model, per-unit inference pricing, from the Oxy pricing source.
- [For organizations](https://oxy.so/ai/enterprise/): Shared, managed and dedicated inference, policy controls, invoicing and auditability.
- [Data and policy](https://oxy.so/ai/trust/): What Oxy does with what you send, and what the provider serving a routed request does with it.
- [Oxy for organizations](https://oxy.so/enterprise/): The cross-Oxy B2B hub.
- [Talk to sales](https://oxy.so/contact/sales/): Sales and private-evaluation requests.

Distinctions that matter when summarising this site:

- **Oxy AI** is the platform, not a model.
- **Oxy Inference** is the public API. It is not a second account system: accounts, applications, credentials and billing live in Oxy Console.
- **Managed Inference** means Oxy serves a model on its own infrastructure. **Dedicated Inference** means a private endpoint and reserved capacity.
- **Alia** is a product built on the platform, with its own plans sold on alia.onl. Alia is not the inference API.
- **Codea** is the coding and agent product.
- **Alia Models** is a future model family. Nothing is released; `alia-v1`, `alia-v1-pro` and `alia-lite` were routing aliases, not models.
- Retention and upstream-training policies are properties of the ROUTE serving a request, not platform-wide guarantees.
